jobs.title: Data Integration Specialist
jobs.description:
You don’t just connect systems, you understand how integration drives real business impact.
As a Microsoft Integration Consultant
at delaware, you combine technical expertise with a consulting mindset. You’re comfortable designing integration landscapes, but you also know how to guide customers through decisions and trade-offs.
If you already have hands-on experience with Azure integration
and want to take the next step into more complex, high-impact environments, this role is built for you.

What will you be doing?

You’ll work as a consultant on integration projects for a wide range of customers, helping them modernize and connect their application landscape.
You will:
Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performing integration solutions
on Microsoft Azure
Work with Azure Integration Services
(Logic Apps, API Management, Azure Functions, Data Factory, …)
Build and contribute to API-driven and microservices-based architectures

Take ownership from solution design to implementation and delivery

Contribute to both development and DevOps activities

Stay up to date with the Azure ecosystem and actively apply new capabilities in your projects
Act as a trusted advisor
for customers, translating technical solutions into business value

Who are we?

You’ll join our Microsoft Integration team
, a close-knit group of 30+ specialists who focus on connecting systems, data, and applications in a scalable way.
We combine deep technical expertise (Azure, .NET, APIs) with a strong consulting mindset. Knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and ownership are key in our team.
We don’t just deliver integration solutions, we help customers future-proof their application landscape.

Is there a match?

We’re looking for someone who already has a solid foundation in integration
and is ready to grow further.
You:

Have 2-3
years of experience with Azure integration technologies

(Logic Apps, API Management, Data Factory, Azure Functions, BizTalk, or similar)
Have working knowledge of .NET / C# / Typescript
or similar.
Understand integration patterns, APIs, and distributed systems
(or are eager to deepen this quickly)
Are comfortable in a customer-facing role
and communicate clearly
Speak Dutch and English fluently
(French is a plus)

👉 We are explicitly looking for candidates with hands-on Azure integration experience
, this is not an entry-level role.

What you can expect

Complex and varied projects where integration is business-critical
, not an afterthought
The opportunity to grow into roles such as Solution Architect or Integration Lead

A team where knowledge sharing and coaching
are part of the culture
The flexibility and trust that come with consultancy at delaware

Let's meet up

You’ll be part of a dynamic team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and the chance to work on impactful projects using leading-edge technologies.
Let’s connect to talk more about the job, your talents, your track record, and your future with the #peopleofdelaware!

jobs.title: Azure Integration Specialists
jobs.description:
For a challenging long-term assignment, we are looking for 3 experienced Azure Integration Specialists
to help build a modern Azure-based integration platform.

You will support different teams in implementing scalable API and integration solutions
and contribute to rolling out standards, governance frameworks, and best practices
across the organization.

Location:
Brussels

Languages:
Very good command of English, combined with Dutch and French.

Your Role
Build and further develop the Azure integration platform
.
Support product teams
with migrations and integration-related challenges.
Implement API Management (APIM), Service Bus
, and other Azure Integration Services.
Automate processes using DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
.
Define and promote integration standards and governance
.
Collaborate with architects, developers, and business stakeholders
.

Your Profile

Strong experience with Azure Integration Services
, particularly APIM, Service Bus, and iPaaS
.
Good knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps
.
Experience with the Microsoft ApiOps Framework
and Spectral Linting
.
Hands-on experience with Terraform and/or Bicep
.
Strong .NET / C#
background.
Excellent communication skills
and a pragmatic mindset.
Good command of Dutch and English
.

What Makes This Assignment Attractive

An impactful role within a strategic integration program
.
A modern Azure environment
.
A high degree of autonomy
and opportunities to further develop your expertise.
Collaboration with experienced integration and cloud experts
.

jobs.title: Dotnet Developer
jobs.description:
🧭 .NET Software Engineer – Bern (GreenTech)

📍Bern | 💰 CHF 110'000 - CHF 145'000
+ Bonus | 🌍 Remote

A forward-thinking GreenTech start-up, is seeking an experienced .NET Software Engineer to join their growing team. Focused on building technology that supports sustainability, clean energy, and environmental impact, the company is developing modern digital platforms to help organisations reduce their carbon footprint. They are searching for a skilled .NET Software Engineer passionate about:

C#, C# 13, .NET 9, ASP.NET Core 9, Blazor, MVC, GraphQL, SQL Server 2022, Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Entity Framework Core 9, React 19, Angular 19, TypeScript 5.7+, JavaScript (ES2024+), HTML5, CSS3, Jest 30, Agile, TDD, Programmer, Full Stack Engineer, .NET Architect, .NET Software Engineer.

About the Role:

As a .NET Software Engineer, you will play a key role in developing and scaling cloud-native platforms that support sustainable technologies and data-driven environmental solutions.
This position offers an excellent opportunity for a .NET Software Engineer to work across the full stack, contribute to architectural decisions, and help shape the technical direction of a fast-growing GreenTech organisation. The role is well suited to a .NET Software Engineer who enjoys working in impact-driven environments.

➕ Nice to Have:

Experience using Agile methodology.
Strong communication and analytical skills, with a passion for learning and problem-solving.
Hands-on experience as a .NET Software Engineer using C#, .NET 9, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, MVC, GraphQL, SQL Server 2022, Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Entity Framework Core, React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Jest, Agile, TDD, Programmer, Full Stack Engineer, .NET Architect, .NET Software Engineer.

💪 Benefits:

Remote working options available.
Comprehensive health insurance.
Professional development opportunities, including training in modern .NET, cloud platforms, and GreenTech-focused systems.

✉️ Due to the high number of applications, we may not be able to respond to everyone, but we truly appreciate the time and effort taken to apply and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates.

jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Full Stack .NET Developer – Zug (Hybrid)

(Tech stack: .NET, C#, Angular, REST APIs, SQL, CI/CD, Git)

Our client, a growing software consultancy, is looking to hire a Full Stack .NET Developer to join their team in Zug.

This is a hybrid role (3 days in the office, 2 days at home) offering the opportunity to work on modern, scalable applications across a variety of projects. There is a strong emphasis on front-end development using Angular, so experience building high-quality user interfaces is essential.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain full stack applications using .NET and C#.
Build responsive, user-focused interfaces with Angular.
Work closely with designers, product teams, and other developers.
Contribute to technical design and architecture decisions.
Ensure code quality through testing, reviews, and best practices.
Participate in Agile development processes.

Skills & Experience:

Strong backend development experience with .NET / C#.
Proven hands-on experience with Angular (essential).
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern tooling.
Knowledge of SQL or NoSQL databases.

Languages:

German (C1/C2) is essential
English is beneficial

Location: Zug, Switzerland (Hybrid – 3 days office, 2 days home)
Salary: CHF 90,000 – CHF 120,000

This is an excellent opportunity to join a modern, collaborative environment where you’ll work on diverse projects and continue to develop your technical skills.
Applicants must have the right to work in Switzerland.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer – Digital Solutions – Zurich / Hybrid

(Tech stack: C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, Microsoft SQL Server, Entity Framework, Visual Studio, Web Development, Windows Server, Agile)

Are you a Senior Full Stack Developer looking to work on meaningful technology that has a direct impact on its users? Do you enjoy working across both backend and frontend development while having the freedom to shape technical solutions from concept through to delivery? This is an exciting opportunity to join a forward-thinking organisation developing modern digital applications used every day by a diverse user community.

Our client is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join an experienced development team responsible for the design, development and continued enhancement of internal software solutions. You will work across the full development lifecycle, developing modern web applications and RESTful services using C#, ASP.NET Core and .NET Core, alongside frontend development with Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.

A key part of the role will involve developing scalable solutions using Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework, working with complex data models and large datasets while identifying opportunities for performance optimisation. You will also contribute to technical specifications and interface documentation, develop and execute test cases, and ensure solutions are well documented and maintainable. Experience with Windows Server environments, including application and database servers and virtualised environments, would be advantageous.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically strong and analytical developer who enjoys solving complex problems and taking ownership of their work. You'll have significant scope to contribute ideas, prioritise effectively and work collaboratively with an experienced team to develop sustainable, practical solutions.

Location:
Zurich, Switzerland / Hybrid working
Salary:
CHF 90,000 – CHF 130,000 + Benefits
Working Pattern:
80–100%
Language:
Fluent German, both written and spoken (C1 and above), is essential.

Applicants must have the right to work in Switzerland as the role does not provide sponsorship.
